completions.sysinfo:
#compdef sysinfo

# Generated by `sysinfo --completions zsh`; edits are lost on the next sync.

_sysinfo() {
    local context state state_descr line ret=1
    typeset -A opt_args
    _arguments -s -S -C \
        '(- *)--completions=[Print shell completions and exit]:completions:(zsh)' \
        '(--pretty -p)-p[show the complete branded hardware presentation]' \
        '(--pretty -p)--pretty[show the complete branded hardware presentation]' \
        '(--full -f)-f[include the extended inventory]' \
        '(--full -f)--full[include the extended inventory]' \
        '(--health -hh)-hh[explain active errors and warnings]' \
        '(--health -hh)--health[explain active errors and warnings]' \
        '(- *)--help[Show this message and exit.]' \
        '1: :->command' \
        '*:: :->argument' && ret=0
    case $state in
        command)
            local -a commands
            commands=(
                'bench:Measure this machine and compare runs over time.'
            )
            _describe -t commands 'sysinfo command' commands && ret=0
            ;;
        argument)
            case $line[1] in
                bench) _sysinfo__bench && ret=0 ;;
            esac
            ;;
    esac
    return ret
}

_sysinfo__bench() {
    local context state state_descr line ret=1
    typeset -A opt_args
    _arguments -s -S -C \
        '(- *)--help[Show this message and exit.]' \
        '1: :->command' \
        '*:: :->argument' && ret=0
    case $state in
        command)
            local -a commands
            commands=(
                'run:Measure this machine and store the result.'
                'show:Show a stored run.'
                'list:List stored runs.'
                'health:Report warnings derived from the benchmark history.'
                'compare:Compare two runs.'
                'trend:Show one metric over time.'
                'baseline:Set or clear the baseline for a machine and hardware configuration.'
                'document:Regenerate benchmarks/BENCHMARKS.md from the stored runs.'
                'prune:Thin old runs, keeping baselines and the oldest run of each configuration.'
            )
            _describe -t commands 'sysinfo bench command' commands && ret=0
            ;;
        argument)
            case $line[1] in
                run) _sysinfo__bench__run && ret=0 ;;
                show) _sysinfo__bench__show && ret=0 ;;
                list) _sysinfo__bench__list && ret=0 ;;
                health) _sysinfo__bench__health && ret=0 ;;
                compare) _sysinfo__bench__compare && ret=0 ;;
                trend) _sysinfo__bench__trend && ret=0 ;;
                baseline) _sysinfo__bench__baseline && ret=0 ;;
                document) _sysinfo__bench__document && ret=0 ;;
                prune) _sysinfo__bench__prune && ret=0 ;;
            esac
            ;;
    esac
    return ret
}

_sysinfo__bench__run() {
    local ret=1
    typeset -A opt_args
    _arguments -s -S \
        '(--tier)--tier=[quick, standard or heavy.]:tier:(quick standard heavy)' \
        '(--only)--only=[Comma separated families to measure.]:only:_values -s , family cpu mem cache disk gpu thermal workload' \
        '(--note)--note=[Why this run was taken.]:note:' \
        '*--tag=[Label for this run.]:tag:' \
        '(--host)--host=[Record against this host.]:host:_sysinfo_complete_known_hosts' \
        '(--workdir)--workdir=[Directory the disk tier writes in.]:workdir:_files -/' \
        '(--force)--force[Measure despite poor conditions.]' \
        '(--no-save)--no-save[Print without storing.]' \
        '(--baseline)--baseline[Pin this run as the baseline.]' \
        '(--json)--json[Emit the run as JSON.]' \
        '(- *)--help[Show this message and exit.]' && ret=0
    return ret
}

_sysinfo__bench__show() {
    local ret=1
    typeset -A opt_args
    _arguments -s -S \
        '(--json)--json[Emit the run as JSON.]' \
        '(- *)--help[Show this message and exit.]' \
        '1::target:_sysinfo_complete_runs' && ret=0
    return ret
}

_sysinfo__bench__list() {
    local ret=1
    typeset -A opt_args
    _arguments -s -S \
        '(--host)--host=[Only this machine.]:host:_sysinfo_complete_bench_hosts' \
        '(--limit)--limit=[Rows to print.]:limit:' \
        '(--all)--all[Include noisy and aborted runs.]' \
        '(- *)--help[Show this message and exit.]' && ret=0
    return ret
}

_sysinfo__bench__health() {
    local ret=1
    typeset -A opt_args
    _arguments -s -S \
        '(--host)--host=[Machine to judge.]:host:_sysinfo_complete_bench_hosts' \
        '(- *)--help[Show this message and exit.]' && ret=0
    return ret
}

_sysinfo__bench__compare() {
    local ret=1
    typeset -A opt_args
    _arguments -s -S \
        '(--json)--json[Emit the comparison as JSON.]' \
        '(- *)--help[Show this message and exit.]' \
        '1::left:_sysinfo_complete_runs' \
        '2::right:_sysinfo_complete_runs' && ret=0
    return ret
}

_sysinfo__bench__trend() {
    local ret=1
    typeset -A opt_args
    _arguments -s -S \
        '(- *)--help[Show this message and exit.]' \
        '1::target:_sysinfo_complete_runs' \
        '2::metric:_sysinfo_complete_metrics' && ret=0
    return ret
}

_sysinfo__bench__baseline() {
    local ret=1
    typeset -A opt_args
    _arguments -s -S \
        '(- *)--help[Show this message and exit.]' \
        '1::action:(set clear show)' \
        '2::target:_sysinfo_complete_runs' && ret=0
    return ret
}

_sysinfo__bench__document() {
    local ret=1
    typeset -A opt_args
    _arguments -s -S \
        '(- *)--help[Show this message and exit.]' && ret=0
    return ret
}

_sysinfo__bench__prune() {
    local ret=1
    typeset -A opt_args
    _arguments -s -S \
        '(--host)--host=[Only this machine.]:host:_sysinfo_complete_bench_hosts' \
        '(--keep)--keep=[Runs to keep per configuration.]:keep:' \
        '(--dry-run)--dry-run[Report without deleting.]' \
        '(--yes)--yes[Delete without confirming.]' \
        '(- *)--help[Show this message and exit.]' && ret=0
    return ret
}

_sysinfo_complete_bench_hosts() {
    local -a items
    items=(${(f)"$(_call_program sysinfo-values sysinfo __complete bench-hosts 2>/dev/null)"})
    (( $#items )) || return 1
    _describe -t values 'host' items

    _describe -t values 'run' items
